g.text: I1/I2/E1/E2 are logical Kelvin terminals, NOT footprint pad numbers. Main charger/UPS attach to BAT_PROTECTED.

g.desc: I1/I2/E1/E2 are logical Kelvin terminals, NOT footprint pad numbers. Main charger/UPS attach to BAT_PROTECTED.

g.text: No PWR_FLAG, no ERC exclusions, no production footprint claims.

g.desc: No PWR_FLAG, no ERC exclusions, no production footprint claims.

g.text: BAT_GUARDED: future protected-pack + board guard output. U601 BAT bias BYPASSES shunt; no full-current claim.

g.text: R602 is fixed BIN insertion bias, NOT an NTC. R606/R607 DNP; actual I2C pullups require MainBoard audit.

g.text: FG_GPOUT is private, NOT PWR_INT. VDD is decoupling only. Charge voltage/temperature remain OPEN.
